shot: DS-31 A1 opener gag: homework tower topples onto a college student
intent: Dorm desk at night. START: a lean college guy in a grey hoodie sits at his desk, hands on his head, staring up in dread at a ceiling-high leaning tower of textbooks and papers on the desk beside him. END: the tower has toppled onto the desk and onto him; books and papers are piled across the desk and over his shoulders, a few sheets still falling, only his head and one raised hand out, deadpan look at camera. Motion: the tower tips toward him and collapses onto him (falls under gravity, nothing vanishes).

hands.right: on his head in START; raised out of the pile in END
hands.left: on his head in START; under the pile in END
